description: This file defines a custom exception class 'IdempotentCommandProcessSucceedException' used within the Apache Fineract project. It is thrown when a command with the same action, entity, and idempotency key is processed again.

classes.name: IdempotentCommandProcessSucceedException
classes.description: A specialized exception indicating successful processing of an idempotent command.

methods.name: IdempotentCommandProcessSucceedException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with command details and setting the status code based on the command's result status code.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code associated with the command result.
